00-aujourdhui: Today, we're learning the letter d.
02-regarde: Watch how we write the d.
03-depart: We start on the green dot. We make a half round: we turn to the LEFT, we come down, and we come back to the right. And now, CAREFUL: we LIFT the pencil. We go back right to the top, we come straight down, and we finish with the little curve resting on the line.
04-encore: One more time, a little faster.
05-cherchons: Now, let's find words that begin with d.
10-pareil: Did you hear? They all begin the same way.
11-relance: Find a word that begins with d.
